name: What is the cost of upgrading bathroom electrical and lighting in the East Bay area?

mainEntity.name: What is the cost of upgrading bathroom electrical and lighting in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of bathroom electrical and lighting upgrades in the East Bay area, including Berkeley and Oakland, varies widely based on the scope of work. Simple fixture replacements might cost a few hundred dollars, while a complete electrical overhaul with new wiring, dedicated circuits, and multiple lighting zones could range from several thousands. Factors like existing electrical infrastructure, desired materials, and the complexity of the installation all influence the final price. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment.
